query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE userId = u.id) as postCount,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(likes), 0) FROM posts WHERE userId = u.id) as totalLikes,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM postReplies WHERE userId = u.id) as replyCount,
  (SELECT totalHoursStudied FROM leaderboard WHERE userId = u.id) as studyHours,
  (SELECT streakDays FROM leaderboard WHERE userId = u.id) as streakDays
FROM users u WHERE u.email = 'johndoe@example.com';
